title: Ultimate Card Games
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Collection of card games
Collection of card games, single player against the CPU

Solitaire and other card games
Games in the ROM include Hearts, Spades, Euchre, Gin Rummy, Poker, Go Fish, plus solitaires such as Aces Up, Betsy Ross and Eagle Wing
Each game has a rules and history page (Gin Rummy, for example, dates from 1909 New York)

rows: avoid taking tricks with hearts (and the queen of spades in most rule sets)
bid the number of tricks you expect; spades are always trump
build sets and runs; knock when your unmatched cards are low
